data.value: Get workspace runtime statistics (cache capacity, usage, hit rate, etc.)

data.name: XamlFilePathParam
data.value: Absolute path of the XAML file

data.name: VariableNameParam
data.value: Variable name (optional, auto-suggest if not provided)

data.value: Optional code smell type filter (e.g., long-method, large-class)

data.name: PeriodDaysParam
data.value: Change frequency lookback days (only effective for change-frequency type)

data.value: Optional custom rule file path; defaults to dotnet-analyzer.rules.json in the project directory

data.name: AllowedLicensesParam
data.value: Allowed license list (comma-separated, empty means all allowed)

data.value: Optimization strategy: auto (automatic) or aggressive (aggressive cleanup)

data.value: Maximum recursion depth (default 10, 0 = direct calls only)

data.name: CategoriesParam
data.value: Action category filter (refactor, fix, generate, format)

data.value: Whether to apply changes (default false, preview only)
